title: Temporary target from AAPSClient
body:
* AAPS Version: 3.2.0.2
* Connection using NSClientV3 over websocket, temp target sync enabled
* NS 15.0.3

Let's assume aaps with SMB disabled with high temp target. We have active temp target of 8 and 10 minutes remaining.
On AAPS side I can just extend this temp target by entering new one without issues below.

On NSClient side I can also set new temp target but there is different behavior:

1. during the sync on AAPS side there can be SMB issued in between those two high temp targets (looks like cancelling current TT, running the loop and maybe give some insulin, setting new TT that is coming).
2. if there is active automation rule to set temp target for example to 5, this one wins and suppress the one coming from remote (such active rule effectively blocks manually set TT from remote).
